annotations.title: Check a legacy story and its price

description: Check an AI Legacy Story before it is made, without any charge: the exact price in credits, and (with your own `draft`) the script as it will be made, cleaned and fitted (keys, voices, scene and shot seconds). Send the same story, draft, references (ids and kinds, no photos needed here), proofCount and options you will send to start_legacy_story. Show the user the script and the price before you start it.

captions.description: Big burned-in captions of the lines. Default big.

draft.description: Your own script, in the shape legacy_story_guide shows: title, characters, places, blocks (scenes of shots), proofLines.

line.description: At most 12 words, in the story language

speaker.description: Character key of the one who talks (in the shot)

look.description: English: age, build, hair, face, clothes, one signature detail

refId.description: The id of a person reference

sameAs.description: The key of the main character this is a younger or older version of

proofLines.description: One short ALL CAPS line per proof photo

language.description: Language of the spoken lines. Default en.

model.description: Video model. Default minimax-h3 (sharpest, keeps each voice).

music.description: Music bed. Default legacy (dark trap beat, big lift at the end).

proofCount.description: How many real photos the film ends on

quality.description: Size; must be one the model offers (legacy_story_guide). Default: the model's default (H3: 768p).

id.description: Short id the script uses, e.g. r1 (a character's refId, a place's refIds)

kind.description: person = becomes a character; logo / screenshot = shown in a place

name.description: The name the story uses, e.g. 'Grandpa Ali', 'Acme logo'

note.description: A short note, e.g. 'me at 30', 'our first office'

seconds.description: Target length of the animated part. Default 60. With your own script, its scenes set the length.

story.description: The story in the user's words (needed when there is no draft)

name: check_legacy_story
title: Check a legacy story and its price
